schema.description: Match state of an answer. matches_found wins over every condition; an answer without matches names the state of its primary source (logins for attempts, bruteforce_lifecycle for bans: missing table, no rows, failed read, expired or partially expired window), then truncated evidence, then an unresolved identity, then no_matches. Secondary sources only appear in history.conditions. Never read as "nothing happened".
